name: l2cap_find_le_psm

ownership.argument: Borrowed registry entry for the Bluelet owner task only. The registry root is *(owner)+16 on this build.

provenance.source: Walks the PSM registry rooted at *(owner)+16 (owner = dword_2013BDBC), matching the psm word at entry+4 and the kind/state byte at entry+6; for kind 3 it accepts psm <= 0x7F only when entry+6 == 1 and psm >= 0x80 only otherwise, and follows the intrusive previous link at entry-8. Consumed by the connect handler 0xC801AC4 and by the L2CAP route handler 0xC802AEC.

notes: Borrowed registry entry for the Bluelet owner task only. The registry root is *(owner)+16 on this build.
